cases.scenario: Material rule becomes effective for target cohort before release
cases.expected: Preserve old result; hold affected claim; review linked spec/context/behavior/tests and obtain applicable evidence.

cases.scenario: New rule exists but is not yet effective for target cohort
cases.expected: Resolve effective-time and cohort policy; do not apply a universal latest-version rule. Prepare future qualification as needed.

cases.scenario: Source formatting changes without behavioral effect
cases.expected: Record reviewed impact determination; retain evidence whose applicability is established.

cases.scenario: Coding-agent model changes but tested deterministic application artifact is unchanged
cases.expected: Record development provenance; do not automatically invalidate application test results; qualify the new agent for future runs.

cases.scenario: A model or prompt shipped in the product changes
cases.expected: Reassess affected runtime behavior and required evaluations for the release bundle.

cases.scenario: Source access revoked while context is cached
cases.expected: Enforce current permissions; invalidate unauthorized derived access and follow retention/access rules for historical evidence.

cases.scenario: Required retrieval source times out and returns no records
cases.expected: Mark retrieval unavailable; do not treat as successful empty evidence. Pause the affected decision and assign recovery.

cases.scenario: No graph edge identifies an external consumer
cases.expected: Expose incomplete coverage; investigate supported consumers rather than infer no impact.

cases.scenario: Implementation and generated tests share the same wrong assumption
cases.expected: Use domain-owned preservation/acceptance cases and review to challenge behavior; test volume alone cannot establish readiness.

cases.scenario: Artifact digest or behavior-affecting configuration changes after release approval
cases.expected: Reject mismatched release binding; obtain applicable checks and authorization for the actual candidate.

cases.scenario: Deployment event is duplicated or tracker update fails
cases.expected: Deduplicate by event/release identity; queue tracker repair; do not repeat deployment.

cases.scenario: Optional trace dashboard unavailable but required durable release evidence exists
cases.expected: Proceed only under declared non-blocking policy; expose telemetry lag and repair owner. Missing required records would hold release.

cases.scenario: Rule changes while an application is already in flight
cases.expected: Apply domain-approved effective-time/in-flight semantics; preserve prior decisions and route unresolved state to an owner.

cases.scenario: Second team adopts the existing harness template
cases.expected: Qualify its domain cases, sources, permissions and adapters; do not inherit the first team's business evidence.
